text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

RICE SALE - The Japanese Food Agency said on Wednesday it bought 7,000 tonnes of rice at an import tender. Of the total, 5,773 tonnes came from the United States, 408 from China, 204 from Vietnam, 190 from Thailand, 153 from Uruguay, 153 from Egypt and 68 from Australia, the agency said.
SOYOIL SALE - China bought 26,000 tonnes of U.S. soyoil on Tuesday for shipment during the first half of January, exporters said. The purchase was made at $511.00 per tonne, a soybean trader said.

WHEAT TENDERS - Sri Lanka's state buying arm the Co-operative Wholesale Establishment has opened a tender for 100,000 tonnes of soft and hard wheat, government officials said. The tender, closing on January 3, is for 50,000 of soft wheat for delivery in the third week of January and 50,000 tonnes of hard wheat for delivery in the second week of February.

...The CCC said it would seek up to 30,000 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better hard red winter wheat under its export donation program to Bosnia. The shipment period was slated for January 25-February 20. Offers were due January 7.

WHEAT TENDER - Bangladesh has tendered for 100,000 tonnes of U.S. grade-2 or Australian Standard or better Canadian winter red/spring wheat for shipment by February 21, food ministry officials said on Sunday. The ministry would open the tender on January 18. The result of the bidding will be known within two to three days after opening the tender.

WHEAT TENDER - Yemen has postponed until January 7 a soft wheat grain and soft wheat flour tender initially scheduled for December 26, European grain traders said Monday. Yemen is seeking 200,000 tonnes of optional soft wheat flour for shipment between February and June and 200,000 tonnes of new crop U.S. or Canadian or Australian soft white wheat for July-September shipment, they said.

SOYBEAN OIL TENDER - The CCC of the USDA said it would tender for 10,370 tonnes of U.S. bulk crude degummed soybean oil for donation to Peru. The delivery period was slated for February 3-18. Offers were requested by January 7. Successful offerers will be notified on January 8.

LENTIL TENDER - Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade has offered 10,000 tonnes of lentils from the 1996 crops for export, an official spokesman said. He said December 30 was set as the final date to receive bids and results would be announced on December 31.
